# The files and function slices .github/scripts/check-ui-parity-lint.py lints:
# everything RedShipBlueShip added that draws player-facing ImGui or feeds it
# strings. Format: <SET> <path>[::<function>]   (# starts a comment)
#
#   MENU           SohMenu registrars this project owns (menu pages)
#   PANES          our GuiWindow panes and overlays
#   SETTINGS_PANE  the subset of PANES that is a settings surface (S4 applies)
#   TOASTS         the TUs whose notification toasts carry hand-picked colours
#   PTR            a project-added function inside an SoH-shipped file
#   STRINGS        tables and views whose strings reach the player (S7 only)
#   EXCLUDED       draws ImGui, deliberately not linted, with the reason
#
# Every ImGui-drawing TU under src/common and every *SingleExe*.cpp must appear
# here in SOME set (rule S0), so a new surface cannot escape the lint. A listed
# path that does not exist is an error, not a skip.

MENU games/oot/soh/SohGui/SohMenuCombo.cpp
MENU games/oot/soh/SohGui/SohMenuComboMmEnhancements.cpp

PANES src/common/ComboMmOptionsWindow.cpp
PANES src/common/ComboSpoilerWindow.cpp
PANES src/common/ComboTrackerWindow.cpp
PANES games/oot/soh/SohGui/CreationProgressOverlay.cpp
SETTINGS_PANE src/common/ComboMmOptionsWindow.cpp

TOASTS games/oot/soh/Enhancements/randomizer/ForeignItemsSingleExe.cpp
TOASTS games/mm/2s2h/Rando/ForeignItemsSingleExe.cpp

PTR games/oot/soh/SohGui/SohMenuRandomizer.cpp::AddCrossGamePointerWidgets

STRINGS games/oot/soh/SohGui/SohMenu.cpp
STRINGS games/mm/2s2h/Rando/OptionsUiSingleExe.cpp
STRINGS src/common/combo_settings_view.cpp
STRINGS src/common/gen_progress_overlay.c
STRINGS src/common/combo_mm_options_view.c
STRINGS src/common/combo_mm_tricks_view.c

EXCLUDED src/common/ComboSettingsWindow.cpp   retired from the menu; console-only, kept with its lock
EXCLUDED src/common/ComboMenuBar.cpp          compiled but never constructed
